an5.208:1.3: Acakkhussaṃ, mukhaṃ duggandhaṃ hoti, rasaharaṇiyo na visujjhanti, pittaṃ semhaṃ bhattaṃ pariyonaddhanti, bhattaṃ assa na cchādeti.
an5.208:1.4: Ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā dantakaṭṭhassa akhādane. 3.
an5.208:2.3: Cakkhussaṃ, mukhaṃ na duggandhaṃ hoti, rasaharaṇiyo visujjhanti, pittaṃ semhaṃ bhattaṃ na pariyonaddhanti, bhattaṃ assa chādeti.
an5.208:2.4: Ime kho bhikkhave pañca ānisaṃsā dantakaṭṭhassa khādane
